requirement: Voice sign-in asks for spoken email and keeps confirmation, private OTP and shared microphone

oracle.invariant: EN and VI guides ask the person to say their email, then confirm before requesting a code, including regional language tags. Spoken email fills the panel and is read back; no OTP request occurs before yes or đúng. Spoken six digits verify once on the same microphone, with no credentials in model turns or sessionStorage; the next normal utterance resumes website context. Rejected email, partial code, paused listening and stale code callbacks after Google/phase changes never submit a code.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: spoken auth happy path fills email, confirms before OTP, verifies six digits and resumes without a model turn
email rejection does not send OTP; paused or changed-phase queued code cannot verify
voice sign-in confirms the spoken email and verifies OTP without replacing the microphone
Vietnamese regional voice guide accepts spoken confirmation and six digits on the same microphone
